notes: Best-supplied of the five tasks so far. TMax contains a real cluster of user-space Nginx tasks, two of which (task_005935_cd483540, task_007982_fd0af271) specify limit_req_zone/limit_req on port 8080 by name - as close to this TB2.1 task as the pool gets. TerminalWorld and RTS contribute the configure-and-verify-a-web-server genre but almost entirely Apache/LAMP rather than Nginx (RTS's 713 'nginx' hits are overwhelmingly the same create-user-xiaou and Kubernetes-manifest templates; discounted). No task anywhere in the pool mentions log_format, error_page or a custom 404 page for a web server, so the logging-format half of this task is unrepresented - worth flagging for coverage. SWE-Smith's gunicorn/daphne/starlette cluster and SWE-Rebench's django-axes client-IP and user-agent issues are the honest best of those two corpora, capped at overall 3.
